channel.title: Fintech | System Design
channel.description: In-depth system design tutorials — from zero to millions of users. Written for engineers who want to understand how large-scale systems actually work.

item.title: Design a Digital Wallet
item.author: abhaypratap3537@gmail.com (Abhay)
item.description: Four designs, each one fixing what the last one broke. In-memory sharding, two-phase commit, TC/C and Saga, then event sourcing — and why the only data that truly needs to be durable is the event log. With an interactive replay you can scrub.
item.content:encoded:
Four designs, each one fixing what the last one broke. In-memory sharding, two-phase commit, TC/C and Saga, then event sourcing — and why the only data that truly needs to be durable is the event log. With an interactive replay you can scrub.

item.title: Design a Payment System
item.author: abhaypratap3537@gmail.com (Abhay)
item.description: Ten transactions per second, and the hardest correctness problem in the series. Double-entry bookkeeping, exactly-once as retry plus idempotency, and why reconciliation is the last line of defence — with an interactive ledger you can't unbalance.
